summary: Dead-end court head under trees; houses 11 to 14 m away, fairly steep.
reasons: Houses 11 to 14 m, homes all round

drivers.seclusion: Houses 11 m and 14 m away on this side and more across the turning head; trees screen some.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed court head with a bare dirt patch and trees at its west end; a van fits but may obstruct the turning area.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end court, almost no through traffic.
drivers.convention: No signs and no parked cars seen on this kerb.

sun_shade: Heavy tree shade over the west half; open to afternoon sun from the west only through gaps.
cannot_judge: Whether the turning head is kept clear

best_section.where: North side of the Vinca Court turning head, west end by the trees
